name: Delivery for Marin
summary: In Gadgetzan, Sprinkle sends Violet Powder to Marin Noggenfogger and reminds her of the favor Marin owes.

sections.title: A Town Delivery
sections.body: In Gadgetzan, Sprinkle gives you Violet Powder after you bring her the Violet Tragan. Marin Noggenfogger is in the same town, and Sprinkle asks you to remind Marin that she owes a favor.

faq.q: Who sends you to Marin Noggenfogger?
faq.answer: Sprinkle sends you to Marin Noggenfogger with Violet Powder after you bring her the Violet Tragan.
Sprinkle gives you Violet Powder to deliver to Marin Noggenfogger.
Marin Noggenfogger is in Gadgetzan, the same town as Sprinkle.

faq.q: What message does Sprinkle want passed to Marin?
aliases: what does sprinkle say to marin
faq.answer: Sprinkle asks you to tell Marin Noggenfogger that Marin owes her a favor.
